text:
Tom (eng-oncall): quick sync — following the storage/kv eviction latency postmortem, we need to decide which tests to add to prevent recurrence. thoughts?
Aisha (eng-ml): +1. My initial list: 1) regression prompt set that exercises long-context cache reuse, 2) a kv-eviction microbench under high-concurrency, 3) a short chaos drill for node GPU OOMs.
Ravi (eng-platform): agree those. we should also add a nightly load test that ramps sequence length and parallel sessions; the incident happened under a weird mix of long prefixes + many small queries.
Kara (sre): can we be specific on owners and deadlines? ops wants a canary within 2 weeks.
Tom (eng-oncall): proposed owners: Aisha -> promptset/regression, Ravi -> load test pipeline + CI job, Kara -> chaos drill orchestration + playbook update. target: canary in staging in 14 days, full rollout 6 weeks. ok?
Aisha (eng-ml): I can take the promptset. I'll start with reproducer prompts from the incident repro zip and expand to 200 prompts covering different prefix sizes. ETA: 10 days for initial set.
Ravi (eng-platform): I'll add a `nightly/kv-ramp` job in CI and a smaller `pre-merge/kv-smoke` that runs on PRs touching cache code. Plan: job YAML + grafana dashboards. ETA: 12 days for smoke + dashboards.
Kara (sre): I'll own the chaos drill. Proposed scope: simulate node GPU OOM, network flaps, and heavy KV eviction pressure for 30m. Will document runbook and rollback criteria. ETA: 14 days for first drill plan.
Aisha (eng-ml): For the regression runs, suggest we include a lightweight scorecard comparing outputs vs baseline. If generation diverges > threshold we flag. I can add a small eval harness that runs `pytest -k prompt_regression` and a metrics exporter.
Ravi (eng-platform): snippet I'll use for the CI job — adding here so Aisha can see how it plugs in:
```
name: nightly-kv-ramp
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'
jobs:
  ramp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: scripts/run_kv_ramp.sh --duration 1200 --parallel 50
      - run: scripts/push_metrics.sh
```
Kara (sre): please also tag postmortem link in tickets. ops-bot: can you create a tracking epic and add each of these as sub-tasks with owners + due dates?
ops-bot: Created epic EPI-2317 "kv-eviction-incident-evals". Subtasks: EPI-2317-1 promptset (Aisha) due 1767543210, EPI-2317-2 nightly/ci job (Ravi) due 1767600000, EPI-2317-3 chaos drill (Kara) due 1767603210.
Tom (eng-oncall): nice — let's also add a recurring monthly check to the oncall checklist: "kv eviction regression run and metrics review". Who will own the recurring task?
Ravi (eng-platform): platform can own the monthly automation. I'll add a calendar task and a Grafana alert linking to run results.
Aisha (eng-ml): one more ask: can we add two golden prompts that always run in pre-merge to catch easy regressions? low cost.
Kara (sre): yes please. Add them to `pre-merge/kv-smoke` and annotate in the runbook how to interpret false positives.
Tom (eng-oncall): summary: owners and rough dates assigned, epic created, CI YAML and eval harness being added. Action items: Aisha create promptset PR, Ravi add CI + dashboards, Kara draft chaos runbook + schedule. We'll reconvene in 8 days for status. :thumbsup:
Aisha (eng-ml): ack, starting now.
Ravi (eng-platform): ack, creating PR branch `feature/kv-nightly` today.
Kara (sre): ack — will ping calendar invite for the drill.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: reconvene thread in 8 days (1766549930).
